items.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 어휘의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: The <u>thief</u> stole the painting from the museum.
The sunset was so <u>ordinary</u> that everyone took pictures of it.
Kwon Ki-ok worked hard to <u>achieve</u> her dream.
I <u>received</u> an invitation to the party.
items.explain: 모두가 사진을 찍을 만큼 '아름다운(beautiful)' 노을. ordinary(평범한)는 어색하다.

items.stem: 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 단어로 적절한 것은?
items.box:
• I'm _____ for my dog. I lost him in this park.
• She was _____ at the picture of a woman on the wall.
items.explain: look for ~(~을 찾다) / look at ~(~을 보다).

items.stem: 우리말을 영어로 옮긴 것으로 적절하지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices:
그녀는 옆집에 산다.
⇒ She lives next door.

그는 배가 아파서 침대에 누워 있었다.
⇒ He had a stomachache, so he stayed in bed.

나는 세부 사항을 듣는 것을 잘한다.
⇒ I am good at listening to details.

당시에 여성들은 비행 학교에 들어갈 수 없었다.
⇒ At that time, women couldn't enter to flight schools.

그녀는 수업 전에 전화를 껐다.
⇒ She turned off her phone before class.
items.explain: enter 는 타동사 → enter flight schools (to 없음).

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.explain: hope + that절(현재시제). 주어 your dream 이 3인칭 단수 → comes true.

items.box:
Junho: Minji, what are you reading?
Minji: I'm reading this book My Life with the Chimpanzees.
Junho: Are you interested in chimpanzees?
Minji: Yes, I am. This book is about the life of Jane Goodall and her love for chimpanzees.
Alex: I read the book, too. She's an animal scientist ____ⓐ____ studied chimpanzees for many years.
Minji: You're right. She's the first person to study chimpanzees in the wild. She's my role model.
Junho: Wow, that's great!
Minji: Like Jane Goodall, I'm very interested in animal behavior. And I want to study animals in the wild and help them, too.
Alex: I hope your dream comes true.

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은? (문장의 의미와 어법 모두 고려할 것)
items.explain: 선행사가 사람(an animal scientist)이고 관계대명사절의 주어 자리 → 주격 관계대명사 who.

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답변할 수 <u>없는</u> 내용의 질문은?
choices: When did Jane Goodall first go to Africa?
What does Minji want to do in the future?
items.explain: Jane Goodall 이 언제 아프리카에 갔는지는 나오지 않는다.

items.box:
G: Excuse me. ____ⓐ____ I think I left it here.
M: What does it look like?
G: It's green, and it has a brown handle.
M: Oh, I found it and put it in the umbrella stand.
G: Thanks a lot!
G:Girl / M:Man

items.stem: 위 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
choices: Where can I buy an umbrella?
items.explain: 여기에 두고 간 것 같다며 우산을 보았는지 묻는 상황.

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: 소녀의 우산은 초록색이고 갈색 손잡이가 있다.
items.explain: It's green, and it has a brown handle.

items.stem: 자연스러운 대화가 되도록 (A)~(D)를 바르게 배열한 것은?
items.box:
G: You look busy today.
(A) G: I hope you become a great scientist.
(B) B: Yes, I'm working on a project about Marie Curie. I'm interested in her work in science.
(C) B: I want to be a scientist like her.
(D) G: That sounds interesting!
items.explain: 바빠 보인다 → 프로젝트 중(B) → 흥미롭다(D) → 과학자가 되고 싶다(C) → 훌륭한 과학자가 되길(A).

items.box:
Junho: I can't find my new smartphone. Can you help me?
Kate: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll call you.
Junho: ⓐ<u>Actually, I turned it off.</u>
Alex: What does it look like?
Junho: It's black, and there's a brown bear character on the cover.
Alex: When did you use it last?
Junho: I turned it off before class. Then I think I put it in my backpack.
Kate: Let's look around the classroom.
(a few minutes later)
Kate: I found it! It was inside your textbook.
Junho: Oh, thank you for helping me!

items.stem: 위 대화의 내용으로 볼 때 Kate가 한 일로 알맞은 것은?
choices: 준호에게 전화를 걸어 스마트폰을 찾아 주었다.
준호의 스마트폰 커버에 곰 캐릭터를 그려 주었다.
items.explain: Kate: I found it! It was inside your textbook.

items.stem: 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 문맥상 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 전화해 보겠다는 Kate 에게 전원을 꺼 두었다고 답함 → 전화가 울리지 않는다.

items.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
B: Sumin, what are you going to do this weekend?
G: I'm going to visit the nature museum. ______________
B: That sounds fun!
G: Yeah, I'm so excited.
choices: I hope you become a great scientist.
items.explain: 자연사 박물관에 가는 이유(동물에 관심). 뒤의 That sounds fun! 과 자연스럽다.

items.stem: 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 적절하게 짝 지어진 것은?
items.box: This building ____ⓐ____ about 100 years ago. When I entered it, I was ____ⓑ____ tired that I sat down on the old bench right away.
items.explain: 건물은 '지어지는' 것 → 수동태 was built. so + 형용사 + that ~.

items.stem: 글을 쓴 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box:
Dear Emily,
Welcome to the Historia Museum! Come and see our special rooms. Each room will take you on an amazing journey back in time.
Brave Pilot / Great Adventurer / Powerful Painter / Insect Lover
When: October 1st ― 30th
Where: Historia Museum in Dream City
choices: To invite Emily to the museum's special rooms
To announce the closing of the museum
To sell tickets to a movie about pilots
To ask Emily to write about great people
To explain how to get to Dream City
items.explain: 특별 전시실을 보러 오라는 초대장.

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.box: There was a famous painting in the museum, but it _____. I saw four people leaving the museum. They were Ms. Smith, Ms. Green, Mr. Lee, and Mr. Roberts. One of them is the thief.
items.explain: 그림이 사라졌고(disappeared) 네 사람 중 하나가 도둑.

items.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아 <u>어색한</u> 곳은?
items.box: When she opened the book, she found an old letter from Charles Darwin. ⓐ<u>It said, "Thank you for sending me your book.</u> ⓑ<u>I truly love your work about insects."</u> ⓒ<u>Emily learned that Fabre wrote many books about insects for more than thirty years.</u> ⓓ<u>Fabre never liked reading or writing books.</u> ⓔ<u>His true love for nature was shown clearly in every corner of the room.</u>
items.explain: 30년 넘게 곤충에 관한 책을 쓴 Fabre 가 책 읽기·쓰기를 싫어했다는 문장은 흐름에 어긋난다.

items.stem: 우리말 뜻과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 바르게 배열할 때 <u>네 번째</u>에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
그는 그 그림을 그의 긴 코트 안에 숨겼다.
( hid, painting, He, in, the, coat, his, long )
items.explain: He hid the painting in his long coat. → 네 번째 단어는 painting.

items.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 <u>않은</u> 것은?
choices: The cake which smells delicious is on the table.
The window was broken by a strong wind.
He made me to clean the room.
The story was so funny that we laughed a lot.
items.explain: 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 동사원형 → made me clean the room. (지각동사와 같이 to부정사를 쓰지 않는다.)

items.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 말을 모두 고른 것은?
items.box: The window _____ by the boy yesterday.
items.explain: by the boy 가 있으므로 수동태(be + p.p.)만 가능. broke·opened(능동)는 들어갈 수 없다.

items.stem: 빈칸 어디에도 들어갈 수 <u>없는</u> 단어는? (대소문자 구별하지 않음)
items.box: First, Ms. Jones spoke with Harry, the oldest son, "Someone ate your mom's cake." "What did you do this morning?" "I played soccer, and I came back home _____ 11." "I saw the box on the table and opened it." "There was a cake _____, but I didn't eat it." "What did you do after that?" "I just went to my room." "Hmm.... Then why do you have _____ around your mouth?" "Oh, I ate some chocolate cookies _____ I was hungry."
items.explain: around 11 / a cake inside / crumbs / because. whole 은 들어갈 곳이 없다.

items.box: Emily also found an old newspaper on the desk. It read, "At that time, women couldn't enter flight schools." "However, Kwon Ki-ok ⓐ<u>didn't give up</u> and worked hard to achieve her dream." Kwon Ki-ok did not just fly airplanes. She also fought against Japan for Korea's ____ⓑ____. Emily was moved by the great life story of Kwon Ki-ok.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?
items.explain: give up: 포기하다 → didn't give up = 계속 노력했다.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓑ에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 한국의 독립(independence)을 위해 일본에 맞서 싸웠다.

items.box: Finally, Ms. Jones met Tom, the youngest son. "Tom, you like your mom's cake, right?" "Yeah, I like it." "Actually, I smelled Mom baking a cake in the morning." "But I had a stomachache, so I stayed in bed." "Did you go to the kitchen?" "Yes, I went to the kitchen to take some medicine at about 11:30." "The box was ____ⓐ____, so I could see the cake in it." "Then I closed the box." Ms. Jones smiled and said, "The person who lied ate the cake."

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 ⓐ에 들어갈 말로 적절한 것은?
items.explain: 상자가 열려 있어서 케이크를 볼 수 있었다. 뒤에 Then I closed the box.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: Tom은 아침에 엄마가 케이크를 굽는 냄새를 맡았다.
Tom은 상자를 열어 둔 채로 나왔다.
items.explain: I smelled Mom baking a cake in the morning. (약을 먹으러 갔고, 상자를 닫았다)

items.stem: (A)~(D)에 대해 바르게 설명한 사람만을 <보기>에서 <u>모두</u> 고른 것은?
items.box:
Ben was sitting on the bench in the park yesterday. He saw a boy (A)<u>riding</u> a bike. Ben heard a girl (B)<u>play</u> the violin on the stage. Mr. Owl is a wise detective (C)<u>who</u> can solve any problem. The person (D)<u>which</u> stole the painting is Mr. Roberts.

<보기>
ⓐ 수연 : (A)는 지각동사 saw의 목적격 보어로 현재분사가 쓰인 거니까 동사원형 ride로 바꿔 써도 돼.
ⓑ 예지 : (B)는 heard 뒤의 목적격 보어 자리라서 play를 to play로 고쳐야 해.
ⓒ 민수 : (C)의 who는 선행사 a wise detective를 꾸며 주는 주격 관계대명사로 바르게 쓰였어.
ⓓ 지현 : (D)는 선행사가 사람이니까 which를 who나 that으로 고쳐야 해.
items.explain: 지각동사의 목적격 보어는 동사원형/현재분사(ⓐ 맞음, ⓑ 틀림). 사람 선행사 → who/that(ⓓ 맞음).
items.source: L5 Wrap Up 6 · Express Our Thoughts · 지각동사 · 관계대명사
